purpose: 第一科学主线的研究综合与续接；不是第21轮证明认证或完整查新
reported_not_retrieved: Round21 analytic proof and comparison proof; local commit 5d8f86c not returned by connected repository

literature.entry: Claude LeBrun. *Ricci Curvature, Minimal Volumes, and Seiberg–Witten Theory*. Inventiones Mathematicae 145 (2001), 279–316. arXiv:math/0003068. 全文重点：Proposition3.2、Theorem3.3、Corollary3.4及曲率泛函；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0003068)。
Claude LeBrun. *Four-Manifolds, Curvature Bounds, and Convex Geometry*. arXiv:math/0611450. 全文重点：实际类、凸包、正权重重标度Lemma3.7；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0611450)。
Dieter Kotschick. *Monopole Classes and Einstein Metrics*. IMRN (2004), 593–609; arXiv:math/0306022. 实际／generic／special类及其区别；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0306022)。
Masashi Ishida and Claude LeBrun. *Curvature, Connected Sums, and Seiberg–Witten Theory*. arXiv:math/0111228. 连接和、稳定上同伦输入与曲率不变量；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0111228)。
Claude LeBrun. *Einstein Metrics, Four-Manifolds, and Differential Topology*. arXiv:math/0404359. 周期平面与四维Einstein障碍背景；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0404359)。

Andrzej Derdziński. *Self-dual Kähler Manifolds and Einstein Manifolds of Dimension Four*. Compositio Mathematica 49 (1983), 405–433. 原始出版记录及后续论文中明确引用的结构命题；[原文入口](https://www.numdam.org/item/CM_1983__49_3_405_0/)。

Kouei Sekigawa. *On Some Compact Einstein Almost Kähler Manifolds*. Journal of the Mathematical Society of Japan 39 (1987), 677–684. 精确almost-Kähler／非负标量范围；[DOI](https://doi.org/10.2969/jmsj/03940677)。
Claude LeBrun. *Einstein Metrics, Harmonic Forms, and Symplectic Four-Manifolds*. arXiv:1408.1078. 调和形式与光滑拓扑，使用时保留全部零集／符号条件；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/1408.1078)。
Claude LeBrun. *Einstein Metrics, Harmonic Forms, and Conformally Kähler Geometry*. arXiv:1903.00956. 谱、形式与共形几何；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/1903.00956)。

Giovanni Catino and Davide Dameno. *Conformal Kähler Rigidity of Einstein Four-Manifolds*. arXiv:2607.21538v1, 23 July 2026. 全文重点：Theorems1.1、1.2、1.4，Corollary1.7及特征形式一阶恒等式；[原文](https://arxiv.org/html/2607.21538v1)。

Joel Fine, Kirill Krasnov and Dmitri Panov. *A Gauge Theoretic Approach to Einstein 4-Manifolds*. New York Journal of Mathematics 20 (2014), 293–323; arXiv:1312.2831. 出版摘要与理论入口；[原文入口](https://nyjm.albany.edu/j/2014/20-18.html)。

Joel Fine, Kirill Krasnov and Michael Singer. *Local Rigidity of Einstein 4-Manifolds Satisfying a Chiral Curvature Condition*. arXiv:1910.09790v2; Mathematische Annalen 379 (2021), 569–588. 摘要明确的负定 $\mathcal R^+$ 局部刚性；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/1910.09790)。
Jeff Cheeger and Gang Tian. *Curvature and Injectivity Radius Estimates for Einstein 4-Manifolds*. JAMS 19 (2006), 487–525. 本轮出版记录及[R14]中精确复述；[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1090/S0894-0347-05-00511-4)。
Yuxin Ge and Wenshuai Jiang. *An ε-Regularity Theorem on 4-Dimensional Shrinking Ricci Solitons and Ricci Flows*. arXiv:1707.05511. 精确Einstein小能量输入与其他方程范畴的区别；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.05511)。

Jeff Cheeger and Aaron Naber. *Regularity of Einstein Manifolds and the Codimension 4 Conjecture*. Annals of Mathematics 182 (2015), 1093–1165. 非塌缩框架；[期刊](https://annals.math.princeton.edu/2015/182-3/p05)。

Wenshuai Jiang and Aaron Naber. *$L^2$ Curvature Bounds on Manifolds with Bounded Ricci Curvature*. Annals of Mathematics 193 (2021), 107–222. 非塌缩与有界Ricci条件；[期刊](https://annals.math.princeton.edu/2021/193-1/p02)。

Aaron Naber and Ruobing Zhang. *Topology and ε-Regularity Theorems on Collapsed Manifolds with Ricci Curvature Bounds*. arXiv:1412.1326; Geometry & Topology 20 (2016). 全文及截图重点：Theorem1.1、Remark1.1，最大秩、半径与附加导数／Einstein条件；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/1412.1326)。

Karen Uhlenbeck. *Connections with $L^p$ Bounds on Curvature*. Communications in Mathematical Physics 83 (1982), 31–42. 本轮原始出版元数据与作者著作索引；本文只引用经典局部小临界能量规范思想，不声称已核准退化几何的推广；[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1007/BF01947069)。
Olivier Biquard. *Désingularisation de métriques d’Einstein. I*. arXiv:1105.4904; Inventiones Mathematicae (2013). 精确去奇异化与曲率障碍；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/1105.4904)。
Tristan Ozuch. *Noncollapsed Degeneration of Einstein 4-Manifolds I*. arXiv:1909.12957. 精确退化与几何控制；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/1909.12957)。
Tristan Ozuch. *Noncollapsed Degeneration of Einstein 4-Manifolds II*. arXiv:1909.12960; Geometry & Topology 26 (2022), 1529–1634. 精确解的粘合—扰动描述及第7.3节的近似问题；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/1909.12960)。
Tristan Ozuch. *Integrability of Einstein Deformations and Desingularizations*. arXiv:2105.13193. 精确障碍与高阶可积性；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.13193)。

Claude LeBrun and Tristan Ozuch. *Desingularizations of Conformally Kähler, Einstein Orbifolds*. arXiv:2601.19215v2, 2026. 本轮核对摘要：正Einstein、Hermitian轨形极限与ASD泡下的KE刚性；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.19215)。
Yiqi Huang and Tristan Ozuch. *Regularity of Einstein 5-Manifolds via 4-Dimensional Gap Theorems*. arXiv:2512.21317v2. 本轮全文重点：四维Einstein轨形间隙对五维Einstein极限正则性的应用；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.21317)。
Rugang Ye. *Ricci Flow, Einstein Metrics and Space Forms*. Transactions of the AMS 338 (1993), 871–896. 本轮核对出版元数据及后继原文的引用，未据此臆写普适夹逼阈值；[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1090/S0002-9947-1993-1108615-3)。

F. Thomas Farrell and Pedro Ontaneda. *A Caveat on the Convergence of the Ricci Flow for Pinched Negatively Curved Manifolds*. arXiv:math/0311176v2. 全文与定理截图：高维输入流不收敛不等于底层无双曲度量；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0311176)。
Fuquan Fang, Yuguang Zhang and Zhenlei Zhang. *Non-singular Solutions to the Normalized Ricci Flow Equation*. arXiv:math/0609254. 长期流与拓扑限制；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/math/0609254)。
Masashi Ishida. *The Normalized Ricci Flow on Four-Manifolds and Exotic Smooth Structures*. arXiv:0807.2169. 动态SW障碍；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/0807.2169)。

Masashi Ishida, Rareș Răsdeaconu and Ioana Şuvaina. *On Normalized Ricci Flow and Smooth Structures on Four-Manifolds with $b^+=1$*. arXiv:0810.2465. 此处只作相关动态chamber问题的原文入口，不当作当前静态加权输入已经完成的证明；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/0810.2465)。

R. İnanç Baykur and Masashi Ishida. *Families of 4-Manifolds with Nontrivial Stable Cohomotopy Seiberg–Witten Invariants, and Normalized Ricci Flow*. arXiv:1011.2744. 稳定上同伦与流的障碍；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/1011.2744)。
Julius Baldauf. *Harmonic Spinors in the Ricci Flow*. Journal of Geometric Analysis 34 (2024), 235; arXiv:2210.14198. 旋量、加权方程与熵；[DOI](https://doi.org/10.1007/s12220-024-01665-y)。
Ursula Hamenstädt and Frieder Jäckel. *Negatively Curved Einstein Metrics on Gromov–Thurston Manifolds*. arXiv:2411.12956v2. 精确负Einstein且不承载局部对称度量的拓扑对照；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.12956)。
Henri Guenancia and Ursula Hamenstädt. *Kähler–Einstein Metrics of Negative Curvature*. arXiv:2503.02838v3, 3 May 2026. 非球商的负曲率KE对照；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.02838)。
Ursula Hamenstädt and Frieder Jäckel. *Stability of Einstein Metrics and Effective Hyperbolization in Large Hempel Distance*. arXiv:2206.10438. 近双曲稳定性方法；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.10438)。

Frieder Jäckel. *Effective Stability of Negatively Curved Einstein Metrics in Dimensions at Least Four*. Journal of Geometric Analysis (2026), DOI:10.1007/s12220-026-02563-1. 本轮核对正式发表摘要，负截面曲率与薄部精确双曲等条件须保留；早期预印本版本维数范围不同，引用不能混合；[期刊](https://doi.org/10.1007/s12220-026-02563-1)。
Klaus Kröncke. *On Infinitesimal Einstein Deformations*. arXiv:1508.00721. 乘积谱、核与形变理论；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/1508.00721)。
Klaus Kröncke. *Stability of Einstein Metrics under Ricci Flow*. arXiv:1312.2224. 局部稳定、可积性与熵方法；[原文](https://arxiv.org/abs/1312.2224)。
